csv_project_name: A/E Service for Research Center Deferred Maintenance Phase 1
csv_scope_of_work: The Research Center Deferred Maintenance Phase 1 project will provide targeted capital improvements intended to extend the useful life of the Research Center (Building 0073), a 119,119 GSF academic and research facility located at 1314 Kinnear Road. The project will address critical deficiencies in the building envelope and base building infrastructure, including roof replacement, exterior envelope improvements, and renewal of major mechanical systems. The project is focused on maintaining the facility in a safe, reliable, and operational condition and is not intended to fully modernize the building or renovate research laboratory spaces. The selected Architect/Engineer will validate existing conditions, refine project scope and phasing, evaluate code impacts, and develop construction documents for implementation.
